title: David J. Taylor Disclosed 6 Stock Trades: Visa, AT&T, Lam Research and More (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. David J. Taylor (OH-2) disclosed six stock trades on October 29, 2026, all dated October 15: purchases of AT&T, RPM International, Prologis and Lam Research, and sales of Visa and Marathon Petroleum. Each was in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Transaction date for all six: Oct 15, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 29, 2026 (14 days later). Member: Rep. David J. Taylor, OH-2 (House). The data also contains exact duplicates of the Prologis and Marathon Petroleum rows (2 extra rows, 8 rows in all); the data cannot show whether they are repeated records or separate trades, so each is counted once here.

What's been disclosed

  • Four purchases: AT&T (T), RPM International (RPM), Prologis (PLD) and Lam Research (LRCX), each $1,001–$15,000.
  • Two sales: Visa (V) and Marathon Petroleum (MPC), each $1,001–$15,000.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Visa, RPM and Prologis higher on October 30 than on October 15, and AT&T, Marathon Petroleum and Lam Research lower.
  • Related filings: the same member's earlier disclosure is in this post.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
14 days after the trades, which were all dated October 15. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 30 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
